description: The pressure test that gates the capability-versioning §-edits (chief/54 ADR, chief/55 §7.2 edit): a provider ships a capability v2 while a v1 subscriber is still live, and the scenario asserts no silent break (ROADMAP.md Phase F2). koine promotes only after a concrete pressure test fails to break the contract (CLAUDE.md conventions). Follows the scenarios/ convention (replayable, cross-plane assertions) as in scenarios/e2e-media-transform.md, which already exercises KCB. Actionable koine-own contract work. Public-safe: bind roles, illustrative CURIEs use the KINP §3.4 placeholder namespaces.
verify: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('schemas/*.json')]; print('schemas ok')"

userStories.title: A mutate-live-schema pressure scenario
userStories.description: Author a scenarios/ pressure test where a provider ships a capability v2 while a v1 subscriber is live, hunting a silent break in the subscriber-compatibility contract the ADR decided.
acceptanceCriteria: A new scenarios/ file (e.g. scenarios/e2e-live-schema-mutation.md) drives a provider evolving a capability's schema from v1 to v2 while a v1 subscriber remains connected, and asserts the subscriber does NOT silently break — per the KCB §7.2 rule (chief/55) and the ADR (chief/54).

The scenario exercises both a compatible change (must not break the v1 subscriber) and, per the ADR's signalling rule, a breaking change (must be signalled, not silent), written adversarially to find the break; assertions use the KCS cross-plane vocabulary.
It follows the scenarios/ convention and scenarios/README.md (illustrative CURIEs use the KINP §3.4 placeholder namespaces; no deployment/product names).

userStories.title: Record the re-ratification resolution
userStories.description: Wire the scenario back to the KCB §7.2 edit so a clean pass re-ratifies it, matching the existing Re-validation notes.
acceptanceCriteria: The scenario carries a Resolution / note recording which KCB (and, if touched, KMI/KFT) spec version its pass gates, mirroring the existing scenarios' Re-validation sections.
On a clean pass the capability-versioning §-edits may return from candidate to ratified; the scenario states this and the affected spec changelog can cite it.
schemas/*.json still parse; the scenario is a behavior test and requires no schema-twin shape change.
